query: UPDATE events SET startDate = DATE_ADD(DATE(startDate), INTERVAL 19 HOUR) + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, endDate = DATE_ADD(DATE(endDate), INTERVAL 22 HOUR) + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE, updatedAt = NOW() WHERE venue LIKE '%Spitfire%' OR organizerName LIKE '%Spitfire%';
